chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, who said:
Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said: “The qasāmah is fifty men in intentional killing, and in accidental killing, twenty-five men, and they must swear by Allah.”

key_terms.الْقَسَامَةُ: the legal procedure of collective oaths used in homicide cases
key_terms.بِاللَّهِ: by Allah, indicating the form of the required oath
key_terms.خَمْسَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ: the number twenty-five, specified for qasāmah in accidental homicide
key_terms.خَمْسُونَ: the number fifty, specified for qasāmah in intentional homicide

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of qasāmah in intentional and accidental killing according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling for qasāmah in cases of homicide. In intentional killing, it is carried out by fifty men, while in accidental killing it is by twenty-five men, and they are required to swear by Allah.
